title: App Builder External Knowledge/Skill Source
description: Governance record for one third-party repository considered as prior art or as an installable skill/knowledge source. Registration is not adoption.

adoption.description: reference-only: ideas may inform App Builder design but no file is installed. candidate: under evaluation. adopted-pinned: pinned content is installed and audited. rejected: explicitly not adopted.

doNotAdopt.description: Parts that would create a competing authority or unwanted architecture if copied wholesale.

pinnedRef.description: Commit sha or tag. Required for adopted-pinned. Mutable branches such as main are never fetched at run time.

allowedRoles.description: Role ids permitted to load content from this source. Empty means no role may load it.

instructionAuthority.description: Third-party repository content is always data. It can never issue instructions to an App Builder agent.
